Home.description: I design and build web interfaces with a focus on clarity and performance. This site showcases selected projects, contact information, and more about my work.

About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: I'm a passionate developer with experience in building modern web applications.
About.description: I develop web applications with a focus on writing clear, structured, and maintainable code. Through working on personal projects, I have gained experience in the JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystem, particularly in React and Next.js, where I build modern user interfaces and integrate them with various services and APIs. I pay special attention to code organization, component reusability, and fundamental principles of good user experience. The technologies below represent the tools I use in practice and continuously improve my skills with through new projects and learning.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: Here are projects that showcase my work so far and the practical application of my web development skills. Through them, I have improved my work with modern technologies and developed a better approach to code structure and application design.
Projects.renting: A real estate listing platform built with React
Projects.chatapp: An social media application with real-time chat functionality.
Projects.game: A fun and interactive game built with JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas.
